metadata.source: LEHD LODES8 Origin-Destination (OD Main, All Jobs)
metadata.selection: Statewide top 500 flows of 20+ jobs, plus each tract's 3 largest inbound and 3 largest outbound flows of 10+ jobs. Not every flow: a display sample.
metadata.coverage_note: Each tract's largest flows, 18% of people who commute between tracts; not all commuting
metadata.note: Tract-to-tract commuting flows. LineString from home to work centroid. Excludes people who live and work in the same tract. Do not sum arcs for commuter totals; use lodes_co.json or lodes_tract_od_co.json.
